descriptionInUI: Gradual ground-target discovery for both sides. Firing reveals a group immediately; visual/EO/IR/ground radar observations reveal nearby groups. Fixed map SAM sites are exempt, frontline SAMs are not. Optional BLUE-view F10 frontline contacts. Temporarily omits generated legacy JTACs. CTLD logistics may stay enabled with 'JTAC autolase targets' off; disable TIC and Moose Autolase. Combined Arms JTAC slots are unrelated. Runtime-created units are not yet registered in the fog. Terrain and cloud cover are approximations; campaign-scale validation is pending. Off by default.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Hide frontline contacts on the F10 map until discovered
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Hide RED frontline icons and show BLUE-only contact pins using the existing discovery and contact lifetime. Includes frontline support infantry and MANPADS. Friendly BLUE units and all non-frontline groups retain their normal icons. Enables F10 Map User Marks for this mission. RED players also lose the native icons of those frontline groups; use this option for BLUE players. Off by default.

Allow AFAC — Area and AFAC — Frontline search and marking missions. Compatible aircraft designate observed targets with laser, IR at night and finite payload smoke. Passenger-capable helicopters embark a thermal-equipped JTAC. AI flights avoid known ground air defences, climbing only with a known threat ceiling, a native aircraft altitude limit and room below the approximate cloud base. Unknown ceilings force standoff; no safe orbit inside the zone causes an abort. Discovering and marking groups earn separate experience. Requires Realistic CAS and no conflicting JTAC scripts. Threat envelopes and cloud slabs are approximations, not guaranteed protection.

Search for this long after actually reaching the patrol, then return to base. Default 60 minutes. Bingo fuel ends the patrol earlier. Discoveries are restricted to the assigned area or frontline segment.

Mark one target for up to this long before selecting a different group. Default 5 minutes. Losing observation, terrain line of sight, leaving the assigned zone, Bingo or loss of the aircraft stops marking sooner. Only one AFAC can reserve an enemy group at a time.
Display discovery and marking reports to the AFAC's coalition only. Default 15 seconds.

All AFACs use this code, default 1688, so laser-guided bombs can be configured before takeoff. Use a valid code from 1511 to 1788, with no 0 or 9 digits. Different AFACs reserve different target groups.
Coordinate format used in discovery and marking reports.

Try to discover an unknown group on its first valid observation, without a preliminary search delay. Enabled by default when Realistic CAS is used. Closer targets are easier; lower aircraft have better visual/EO/IR chances if terrain line of sight is clear. Ground radar has much higher chances and GMTI helps further against moving targets, but still requires an eligible aircraft, role, active radar, search cone and line of sight. No generic low-altitude bonus for radar. Failed rolls retry on later valid scans, no faster than the configured interval (default: 5 simulated seconds); extra vehicles do not give extra rolls. Known contacts refresh without rolls. A firing group is ALWAYS revealed immediately, without a roll. Disable for discovery on the first valid sensor and line-of-sight observation. These are gameplay approximations, not measured sensor performance.
Visual discovery chance per roll at the edge of the effective sensor range, before the airborne altitude penalty.
Visual chance per roll at zero distance, before the airborne altitude penalty. Interpolates linearly to the maximum-range chance. Must be at least the maximum-range chance.
EO/IR discovery chance per roll at the edge of effective optical range, before the airborne altitude penalty.
EO/IR chance per roll at zero distance, before the airborne altitude penalty. Interpolates linearly to the maximum-range chance. Must be at least the maximum-range chance.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Ground radar chance at maximum range (%)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: RBM ground radar discovery chance per roll at the edge of its effective range. Requires active radar, an eligible role, search cone and terrain LOS. No altitude penalty.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Ground radar chance at zero distance (%)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: RBM chance per roll at zero distance. Interpolates linearly to the maximum-range chance. Must be at least the maximum-range chance. Radar geometry and LOS are still required.
Moving-target radar chance per roll at the edge of effective range. The target must have sufficient ground speed and radial motion, and radar/LOS gates must pass.
Moving-target radar chance per roll at zero distance. Interpolates linearly to the maximum-range chance. Must be at least the maximum-range chance. No altitude penalty.

Relative reduction of visual/EO/IR chance at the channel's maximum observation height. Scales linearly from no reduction at ground level to this reduction at the height limit. 60 means multiply by 0.40 at the limit, not subtract 60 percentage points. 0 disables this penalty. Does not affect ground observers or radar.

Minimum simulated time between attempts by one observer for its focused group after the initial search. Default 5 seconds. Scanning can delay a roll further; no catch-up attempts are banked. Firing and known-contact refresh bypass rolls.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Maximum airborne visual observation height (ft AGL)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Above this height, unaided visual observation is unavailable. At this height the full airborne altitude penalty applies. Default about 11483 feet above local ground. Displayed and edited in feet; saved settings and Lua use metres, preserving existing heights. Applies even with rolls disabled; radar is unaffected.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Maximum airborne EO/IR observation height (ft AGL)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Above this height, EO/IR observation is unavailable. At this height the full airborne altitude penalty applies. Default 23000 feet above local ground. Displayed and edited in feet; saved settings and Lua use metres, preserving existing heights. This is a tunable search-model limit, not a guaranteed identification altitude: slant range, weather, cover, line of sight and discovery rolls still apply. Applies even with rolls disabled; radar is unaffected.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Contact lifetime after last observation or shot (seconds)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: How long a revealed enemy group stays known after its last valid observation or shot (default: 600 seconds / 10 minutes). Further observations or firing refresh the timer. When it expires, the group becomes hidden from enemy AI again and must be rediscovered. Discovery is shared by the opposing coalition and reveals the whole group, not just one vehicle. Fixed map SAM sites remain known. This does not hide F10 icons or freeze a moving contact at its last position.

Selects ONE approximate cover profile for the entire mission, not the actual terrain under each vehicle. Automatic chooses by map: desert for Nevada, Iraq, Syria, Persian Gulf, Sinai and Afghanistan; grassland for Caucasus, Normandy, The Channel, Germany and Falklands; tundra for Kola; forest for Marianas. Choose Desert, Grassland, Tundra, Forest or City to override this. Desert permits the longest observation ranges; grassland, tundra, forest and city progressively shorten them. EO/IR and ground radar respond differently. This is not automatic forest/city detection; terrain line of sight is checked separately. For an unsupported map, select a manual profile.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Detailed detection and contact logging (large dcs.log)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Write detailed Realistic CAS search, detection, line-of-sight and contact diagnostics to dcs.log for troubleshooting. Can produce a very large log and add overhead in busy missions. Leave off for normal play; errors and scheduler-overload warnings are still reported. Does not change detection rules or add F10 markers.
